response.sql:
WITH media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
    AVG(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(Bytes AS DOUBLE) / Milliseconds ELSE NULL END) AS avg_byte_rate
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
overall_avg_byte_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_byte_rate) AS cross_avg_byte_rate
  FROM media_type_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(mts.avg_unit_price) AS avg_of_avg_unit_prices,
  AVG(mts.avg_byte_rate) AS avg_of_byte_rates,
  AVG(mts.avg_byte_rate - oabr.cross_avg_byte_rate) AS avg_excess
FROM media_type_stats mts,
     overall_avg_byte_rate oabr
WHERE mts.avg_byte_rate > oabr.cross_avg_byte_rate;

assumptions.assumption: The phrase '(tracks with no size ignored)' applies only to the byte rate calculation, not the unit price. Average UnitPrice is computed over all tracks in each media type; average byte rate only over tracks where Bytes IS NOT NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: The phrase '(tracks with no size ignored)' applies to both metrics: exclude tracks with NULL Bytes from both the average UnitPrice and average byte rate calculations.
